narrative: 孤立感、敬畏、一次游泳、一道天际线：一个身体、一座码头、一座能证明尺度的高塔。前景可以更暖，或更浅淡。
越远的景层，青色越深。喜剧通常在这片水里活不下去。
当近景和远景是同样的青色时，它就是错误的工具。那只是一层色彩渲染，或是青橙色调（Teal and Orange）式的大片调色。
如果z轴上的深度没有伴随色相变化，你就没抓住这个配方。
how: 长焦有助于分出景层（85mm到135mm），或用广角搭配薄雾拍摄水下画面。固定机位。
描述层层叠叠的薄雾、玻璃或水体。保留一个能证明尺度的主体。
提示词：Prompt: Blue-depth world of [Subject], stacked cyan planes, underwater or night glass, distance as a blue gradient.
when: 游入黑暗水域、逐渐远去的夜间城市、置身浓重空气中被孤立的身影。不要把它当作日间街道上的青橙色调来用。
vs: 冷蓝色调（Cool Blue）是整体的色温。蓝色纵深风则是沿z轴（景深方向）的一种渐变。
水下拍摄（Underwater）是常常产生这种效果的媒介，但并不是唯一合法的场景设定。如果近景和远景一样蓝，你得到的只是一层色彩渲染。
examples_film: 《深渊》（The Abyss）用水来构建层层叠叠的蓝色距离感。《银翼杀手2049》（Blade Runner 2049）用逐渐远去的青色景层，衬托更暖的近景物体。
色彩就是z轴。这是语法，不是可以照搬的画面。
mistakes: 青橙色调，或一层平淡的蓝色渲染。破绽是脸部和地平线是同一种色相。
修正方法：层层叠叠的景层、越远越深的青色，以及一个能证明尺度的身体或高塔。

faq.q: 电影中的蓝色纵深风（Blue Depth）是什么？
faq.a: 一种空间性的色调：越远的景层青色越深，距离由此变成一种蓝色渐变。可以是水下、夜晚的玻璃，或浓重的空气。不是一个冷色LUT。

faq.q: 蓝色纵深风（Blue Depth）与冷蓝色调（Cool Blue）的区别
faq.a: 冷蓝色调给整个画面染上一层色调。蓝色纵深风则随距离变化。如果前景和背景一样蓝，你想要的其实是它的近亲，或者说你没做成这个风格。

faq.q: 什么时候该用蓝色纵深风？
faq.a: 孤立感、敬畏、游泳、天际线。跳过喜剧和任何青橙色调的街景调色。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写蓝色纵深风的提示词？
faq.a: 先说明一个能证明尺度的主体，以及层层叠叠的薄雾，然后保持近景比远景更少蓝色。

narrative: Isolation, awe, a swim, a skyline: a body, a pier, a tower that proves scale. Foreground can be warmer or paler.
Receding planes go deeper cyan. Comedy usually dies in this water.
It is the wrong tool when near and far are the same teal. That is a wash, or a Teal and Orange blockbuster grade.
If the z-axis is not a hue change, you missed the recipe.
how: Telephoto helps the planes (85mm to 135mm), or a wide underwater with haze. Lock off.
Describe stacked haze, glass, or water. Keep a subject that proves scale.
Prompt: Blue-depth world of [Subject], stacked cyan planes, underwater or night glass, distance as a blue gradient.
when: A swim into dark water, a night city receding, a figure isolated in thick air. Do not use it as teal-and-orange on a daylight street.
vs: Cool Blue is overall color temperature. Blue depth is a gradient along z.
Underwater is the medium that often produces this, not the only legal set. If the near plane is as blue as the far, you have a wash.
examples_film: The Abyss uses water as stacked blue distance. Blade Runner 2049 uses cyan receding planes against warmer near objects.
Color is the z-axis. Grammar, not a still to copy.
mistakes: A teal-orange grade, or a flat blue wash. The tell is the same hue on face and horizon.
Fix it: stacked planes, deeper cyan in the distance, a body or tower to prove scale.

faq.q: What is Blue Depth in film?
faq.a: A spatial grade: receding planes go deeper cyan, so distance is a blue gradient. Underwater, night glass, or thick air. Not a cool LUT.
Cool blue tints the whole frame. Blue depth changes with distance. If the foreground is as blue as the background, you wanted the cousin, or you failed this look.

faq.q: When should I use Blue Depth?
faq.a: Isolation, awe, swims, skylines. Skip comedy and any teal-orange street grade.

faq.q: How do I prompt Blue Depth for AI image or video?
faq.a: Name a scale subject and stacked haze, then: Blue-depth world of [Subject], stacked cyan planes, underwater or night glass, distance as a blue gradient. Keep the near plane less blue than the far.
